goal:
Implement openspec/changes/add-session-boundary. Read proposal.md, design.md, specs/session-boundary/spec.md, and tasks.md. Check a task only when that behavior is in the tree and covered by bun run test:unit. The contract is already accepted in reviews/2026-11-06-advise-2.md. Do not reopen it and do not edit ARCHITECTURE.md.

Pins to land: core, postgres-js, and node are separate package entries. The core import graph, including dynamic import(), has no node: builtin, no postgres, and no @electric-sql/pglite. The shared session type is Drizzle PgDatabase. ConnectionScope has run, transaction, close, and model(table). scope.model(table) binds a model class for a core-only caller. Captured scope on a model, builder, instance, hook, or association beats a later Node ambient scope. createActiveRecordJS, setGlobalConnection, and runWithConnection live on the node entry and use AsyncLocalStorage plus a node-entry default. Core holds no default session. Unbound User.find works on Node when a scope is bound and throws before any driver call when none is bound. transaction passes a callback scope that uses the driver transaction session and keeps the lease token across hook awaits. The token retires on commit, rollback, and a failed completion. transaction throws on the callback scope and on that same root while the callback is in progress. A different root may transact at the same time. close on the child does not close the root client. close on the root during a callback rolls back, retires the token, and then closes the root client. Nested calls do not flatten and do not open a savepoint.

Move Model, the query builder, associations, the eager loader, and both collection proxies off getGlobalConnection onto the scope they were created with. src/collection-proxy.ts currently dynamic-imports ./connection. That must not pull node: or postgres into core. Leave the sql.raw where interpolation in place. Bound eq and inArray stay parameterized.

Leave src/setup.integration.ts swapping the global connection. Change its import if the symbol moves. scripts/lib/bootstrap.ts imports setGlobalConnection from ../src. Point that import at the node entry.

Do not add @electric-sql/pglite. Do not build the single-session waiter queue, the 5 second timeout, or the Wasmtime process. Edit the owned paths and stop.

anchors.invariant: A core caller binds a model without loading the node entry. Captured scope wins over the node ambient store.
The callback uses the driver transaction session. Re-entry throws on that callback scope and on the same root. A different root may transact. The token retires when the transaction ends.
Core callers stop reading a process-wide PostgresJsDatabase. A missing scope throws before driver I/O.

out_of_scope.item: PGlite client, waiter queue, and 5 second lease timeout
Stop the integration harness from swapping the global connection
Wasmtime process and the reopen spike
